units.prompt: For the existing Wwise RoomVerb effect at {plugin_path}, show me its available properties in a small first page, fetch the next page, and inspect the exact pre-delay property including its range, default and whether its units are disclosed. Then set its pre-delay to {pre_delay} and verify the result. Keep its other settings and all other objects unchanged.

Find the Game Parameter named Repair_WindSpeed and report its exact name, path, range and default. That spelling may be outdated: if there is no exact match, look for the parameter whose name contains Repair_Wind within Game Parameters and use the unique match. This is inspection only; do not change the project.
Create a Game Parameter named Repair_WindRange under {parent_path}, with minimum -12, maximum 36 and default 7. Verify its identity and all three values, and keep existing objects unchanged.

Create an independent Wwise RoomVerb Effect ShareSet named Repair_Independent_Room under {parent_path}. It should be a reusable ShareSet, not an effect attached to a Sound or Bus. Verify its identity, plugin type and parent; do not attach it to any existing object or alter other objects.
